Admission runs through paper. At join the node mails a card holding a one time code to the street address the applicant declares, and the key activates only when that card returns signed for. The registry hashes the normalized address and the delivery receipt together, so fifty seats need fifty doors where a person really picks up mail.

A private mailbox rents 19 dollars monthly, so fifty run 950 dollars a month with no end, and each card needs nine days to land.

A willow leans toward whatever light it finds on the horizon, and a pulse at the door only proves a body stood there.
